lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਚਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਚਰੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਕਿ ਕਰੇਗੁ ਅਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jichar vich da(n)m hai tichar na chetaee k kareg agai jaai ||
lines.translation: As long as there is breath in the body, he does not remember the Lord; what will he do in the world hereafter?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਚੇਤੰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee hoi s cheta(n)n hoi agiaanee a(n)dh kamaai ||
lines.translation: One who remembers the Lord is a spiritual teacher; the ignorant one acts blindly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ethai kamaavai so milai agai paae jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whatever one does in this world, determines what he shall receive in the world hereafter. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur khasamai kaa hukam paiaa vin satigur chetiaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: From the very beginning, it has been the Will of the Lord Master, that He cannot be remembered without the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai a(n)tar rav rahiaa sadaa rahiaa liv laai ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, he realizes that the Lord is permeating and pervading deep within him; he remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਮਿ ਦਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਦਾ ਦੰਮੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dam dam sadaa samaaladaa da(n)m na birathaa jaai ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, he constantly remembers the Lord in meditation; not a single breath passes in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa bhau gaiaa jeevan padavee paai ||
lines.translation: His fears of birth and death depart, and he obtains the honored state of eternal life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਰਤਬਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ihu maratabaa tis no dei jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He bestows this rank upon that mortal, upon whom He showers His Mercy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾਂ ਬੀਨਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape daanaa(n) beeniaa aape paradhaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: He Himself is all-wise and all-knowing; He Himself is supreme.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਲਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape roop dikhaaladaa aape laai dhiaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: He Himself reveals His form, and He Himself enjoins us to His meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੋਨੀ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਥੈ ਗਿਆਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape monee varatadaa aape kathai giaanaa(n) ||
lines.translation: He Himself poses as a silent sage, and He Himself speaks spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਭਨਾ ਹੀ ਭਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kauRaa kisai na lagaee sabhanaa hee bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: He does not seem bitter to anyone; He is pleasing to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਐ ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: usatat baran na sakeeai sad sad kurabaanaa ||19||
lines.translation: His Praises cannot be described; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿੰਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalee a(n)dar naanakaa ji(n)naa(n) daa autaar ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, O Nanak, the demons have taken birth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਿਨੂਰਾ ਧੀਅ ਜਿੰਨੂਰੀ ਜੋਰੂ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਦਾ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: put jinooraa dhee ji(n)nooree joroo ji(n)naa daa sikadaar ||1||
lines.translation: The son is a demon, and the daughter is a demon; the wife is the chief of the demons. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਲੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਖੁਟੀ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hi(n)doo moole bhoole akhutee jaa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: The Hindus have forgotten the Primal Lord; they are going the wrong way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਕਹਿਆ ਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naarad kahiaa s pooj karaa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: As Naarad instructed them, they are worshipping idols.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe gu(n)ge a(n)dh a(n)dhaar ||
lines.translation: They are blind and mute, the blindest of the blind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਥਰੁ ਲੇ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: paathar le poojahi mugadh gavaar ||
lines.translation: The ignorant fools pick up stones and worship them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਾ ਤਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ohi jaa aap dube tum kahaa taranahaar ||2||
lines.translation: But when those stones themselves sink, who will carry you across? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kihu terai vas hai too sachaa saahu ||
lines.translation: Everything is in Your power; You are the True King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat rate ra(n)g ek kai pooraa vesaahu ||
lines.translation: The devotees are imbued with the Love of the One Lord; they have perfect faith in Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਜਨ ਖਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit bhojan naam har raj raj jan khaahu ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is the ambrosial food; His humble servants eat their fill.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh padaarath paaeean simaran sach laahu ||
lines.translation: All treasures are obtained - meditative remembrance on the Lord is the true profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹੁ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t piaare paarabraham naanak har agam agaahu ||20||
lines.translation: The Saints are very dear to the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak; the Lord is unapproachable and unfathomable. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਆਵਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh hukame aavadaa sabh kichh hukame jaai ||
lines.translation: Everything comes by the Lord's Will, and everything goes by the Lord's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko moorakh aapahu jaanai a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaai ||
lines.translation: If some fool believes that he is the creator, he is blind, and acts in blindness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam ko guramukh bujhai jis no kirapaa kare rajaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the Lord showers His Mercy upon him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jogee jugat so paae jis no guramukh naam paraapat hoi ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Yogi, and he alone finds the Way, who, as Gurmukh, obtains the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੀ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਖੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis jogee kee nagaree sabh ko vasai bhekhee jog na hoi ||
lines.translation: In the body-village of that Yogi are all blessings; this Yoga is not obtained by outward show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਐਸਾ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aisaa viralaa ko jogee jis ghat paragat hoi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, such a Yogi is very rare; the Lord is manifest in his heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape ja(n)t upaaian aape aadhaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the creatures, and He Himself supports them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੂਖਮੁ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sookham bhaaleeai aape paasaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself is seen to be subtle, and He Himself is obvious.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਇਕਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap ikaatee hoi rahai aape vad paravaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself remains a solitary recluse, and He Himself has a huge family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਰੇਨਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ma(n)gai daan har sa(n)taa renaar ||
lines.translation: Nanak asks for the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor daataar na sujhaee too devanahaar ||21||1|| sudh ||
lines.translation: I cannot see any other Giver; You alone are the Giver, O Lord. ||21||1|| Sudh||
